  "memo":"R03 holds: the CN IP differs from the US card issuing country and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no other rule condition holds. Device and address counts do not trigger Linkage, so no household exception is needed. No earlier outcome settles the order, and no check has run. Travel with an established device and card, shipping home, is a plausible benign explanation, but does not resolve card ownership. Recommend needs_check under FP-2 §6.6(b), implemented by the analyst as a hold with id_check. Issuer authentication and identity verification are the required next check; contact is not required. Decline and escalation are not permitted on this evidence."
